items.t: Signed, as acting governor, a bill raising the cap on attorney fees in workers compensation cases from 20% to 25%.
items.q: Nicholas Scutari, acting governor of the state while a large part of its executive branch has gone to the Democratic National Convention, signed a bill raising the price cap on attorney fees in workers compensation cases from 20% to 25%.

items.t: Said the state may have "too many watchdogs," citing overlapping work by several oversight bodies and prosecutors.
items.q: Scutari said earlier this year that the state may have “too many watchdogs,” citing overlapping work by the comptroller, SCI, Election Law Enforcement Commission, attorney general’s office, and county prosecutors.

record.t: Signed Executive Order No. 27 ordering U.S. and New Jersey flags to fly at half-staff on October 13, 2026, in mourning of State Senator Sandra Bolden Cunningham.
record.q: Acting Governor Nicholas Scutari today signed Executive Order No. 27, ordering U.S. and New Jersey flags to fly at half-staff on Tuesday, October 13, 2026

record.t: Introduced legislation on Nov. 25 during the lame-duck session and moved it toward a hearing.
record.q: Scutari, a Democrat from Union County, introduced the legislation Nov. 25, right before Thanksgiving, during the lame-duck session, and moved it quickly toward a hearing.

record.t: Served as acting governor in place of the governor, as mandated under the state constitution.
